apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. Rotator cuff tendinopathy with a PT no-overhead-press restriction is a medical restriction, not a preference — that only lifts when the clinician who set it clears it, not by self-assessment. I won't program overhead pressing.

Wednesday's Upper Body Strength can still move weight without going overhead: rows, lat pulldowns, presses kept below shoulder height. Want me to fill Wed Aug 5 with that instead?
